minutes.basis: Intake planning budget for a reading page under the new-course rule in workflow/docs/tools/validators.md (B8): no artifact.html exists yet, so modeledP50 and modeledWorstPath are 0 (not measured), not estimates. The module PR measures the authored page with the frozen estimator, models the worst required path, and raises budget and aboutLabel to at least ceil(max(P50, modeledWorstPath)), at most 15, without compressing other topics. See workflow/evidence/java-foundations/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
